headline: Is NEOM Charges, Raised EPS Guidance and Yara Deal Altering The Investment Case For Air Products (APD)?
summary: In the third quarter of fiscal 2026, Air Products and Chemicals reported sales of US$3,161 million but moved from net income of US$713.8 million a year earlier to a net loss of US$1.44 billion, largely due to project exit charges. Despite the very large GAAP loss, the company delivered better-than-expected adjusted earnings, raised its full-year adjusted EPS guidance, reaffirmed its quarterly dividend of US$1.81 per share, and signed a renewable ammonia marketing agreement with Yara linked...

headline: Air Products and Chemicals Q3 Earnings Call Highlights
summary: Air Products and Chemicals (NYSE:APD) reported fiscal third-quarter earnings per share of $3.47, up 12% from a year earlier and above its prior guidance range, as higher on-site volumes, new assets and equity affiliate contributions offset inflation-related costs and helium pressure.
